```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE addr_state = 'CO'
    AND park_name ILIKE '%Public Archery Range%'
    AND addr_city = 'Lone Tree'
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM park_geom))
),
clipped_high_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             rast,
             (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM park_geom),
             true
           ) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas
),
buffered_park AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geometry, 2000) AS buffered_geom
  FROM park_geom
),
elevation_condition AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT buffered_geom FROM buffered_park))
),
clipped_elevation_condition AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             rast,
             (SELECT buffered_geom FROM buffered_park),
             true
           ) AS rast
  FROM elevation_condition
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM parks p
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
        p.geometry::geometry,
        ST_Union(clipped_elevation_condition.rast)
      )
    AND ST_ValueCount(
        ST_Union(clipped_elevation_condition.rast),
        true,
        1900,
        true
      ) > 0
)
SELECT *
FROM final_result;
```
